title: Kepler's third law
references: Goldstein, H., Poole, C. and Safko, J., Classical Mechanics, 3rd ed., Addison-Wesley (2002)
validity_domain: Orbital period T = 2 pi sqrt(a^3 / (G (m1 + m2))) of an isolated two-body system under Newtonian gravity, with semi-major axis a.
limitations: Two bodies only: perturbations by other bodies are ignored
Newtonian: relativistic corrections are not included
a is the semi-major axis of the relative orbit, not the distance to the centre of mass

variables.a: Semi-major axis of the relative orbit
